measures.sentence: Our likely range, 0.20 to 0.88 homes per 1,000 eligible lots per year (middle 0.45), sits below all of the observed rates (1.1 to 11, 6 observations). Why: The observed places are large cities in high-rent markets with strong state ADU law (most of them in California); our lots include small towns and lower rents, and the reform's take-up range is set from evidence across markets, so a lower rate is expected.
